value_en: Laboratory of Nucleic Acid Chemistry and Nucleic Acid Biomedicine

value_zh: 课题组聚焦新型化学修饰小核酸药物的设计与合成技术，同时利用人工智能创新化学工具与方法，发展生物大分子活性调控与组装递送策略，从分子层面解析核酸药物化学修饰及递送体系的理化性质与药效间的构效关系，推动小核酸药物在癌症、脏器纤维化、眼底病等慢性疾病中的应用。
value_en: The laboratory focuses on the design and synthesis of novel chemically modified small nucleic acid therapeutics. We also use artificial intelligence to develop innovative chemical tools and methods, advance strategies for regulating biomacromolecular activity and for molecular assembly and delivery, and elucidate at the molecular level the structure–property–efficacy relationships among chemical modifications, the physicochemical properties of delivery systems, and the pharmacological performance of nucleic acid therapeutics. Our goal is to promote the application of small nucleic acid therapeutics in chronic diseases including cancer, organ fibrosis, and fundus diseases.
